description: This file defines the Pagination class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It handles generating pagination data for views, including calculation of page links, previous/next links, and rendering the pagination view. The class extends a base Controller class and is intended to be loaded and used by other parts of the Opencart admin interface.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: Handles generating pagination links and rendering pagination HTML for the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination data based on the provided configuration array and returns the HTML output for pagination controls or an empty string if not needed.
